Real Italian cuisine in Da Nang
Sep 2025 • Solo
If you are looking for authentic Italian cuisine in the heart of Da Nang, Amare is a must-see. This restaurant manages to bring the tradition and flavor of Italy thousands of miles away, with a quality and care that are rarely found abroad.

The menu is a journey from the best choices for a first course of seafood and pizza.

Amare is much more than just an Italian restaurant: it is a real refuge for those seeking quality, authenticity and passion for good food. Recommended for those who want to live a true Italian gastronomic experience, even away from home.
